title: Call for Contributions to the EBRAINS 10-Year Roadmap 2026–2036
summary: EBRAINS launched a community-driven call on December 10, 2025 (ISO-8601: 2025-12-10) to define its strategic roadmap for digital neuroscience through 2036. The submission period closed March 15, 2026 (ISO-8601: 2026-03-15), receiving over 159 proposals from more than 25 countries. Selected contributions will be discussed at a symposium in Munich on May 21–22, 2026 (ISO-8601: 2026-05-21 to 2026-05-22) and synthesized into an official framework by Q4 2026. The initiative seeks proposals leveraging EBRAINS' infrastructure for modelling, simulation, data management, and computing, including access to neuromorphic systems like BrainScaleS and SpiNNaker.
tldr: EBRAINS solicited community input via a closed call in March 2026 to shape its decade-long digital neuroscience roadmap ahead of a May 2026 symposium.
evidence: EBRAINS is pleased to announce a call for contributions to the EBRAINS 10-Year Roadmap 2026–2036.
The submission deadline for proposals to the EBRAINS Roadmap was extended to 23:59 CET on 15 March 2026. The submission process is now closed.
More than 160 researchers, clinicians, infrastructure experts... gathered in Munich on 21–22 May for the EBRAINS Roadmap Symposium
Provides access to Europe’s leading supercomputing and neuromorphic systems (e.g., JUPITER, BrainScaleS, SpiNNaker)
